prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: There isn’t one single “best” HVAC company for everyone — the right choice depends on your location in Houston, whether it’s a residential or commercial job, how urgent the repair is, your budget, and whether you need same‑day/emergency service or a warranty-covered repair.

If you want quick options, these are commonly well‑reviewed choices in Houston (you should verify availability and reviews in your ZIP code):
- John Moore Services — long‑established Houston company, residential & commercial, often recommended for emergency repairs and maintenance.
- Baker Brothers Plumbing, Air & Electric — locally known for good customer service and quick response.
- ARS/Rescue Rooter — nationwide company with local crews; often has 24/7 emergency service.
- One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning (local franchise) — franchisees often advertise on‑time guarantees and fast service.
- Champion/Local Champion HVAC franchises — commonly available and offer maintenance plans.

How to pick the best one for your situation (quick checklist):
- License & insurance: confirm Texas licensing/registration and proof of liability insurance.
- Certifications: look for NATE‑certified technicians and ACCA or manufacturer certifications if you need brand warranty work.
- Reviews & references: check Google, Yelp, Angi/HomeAdvisor, BBB and recent Google reviews for your neighborhood.
- Written estimate: get a clear written estimate with parts, labor, diagnostic fee and warranty details.
- Warranties & guarantees: ask about parts/labor warranties and any satisfaction or on‑time guarantees.
- Emergency availability: confirm response time and after‑hours fees if AC is down now.
- Pricing transparency: beware of very low initial quotes that balloon after diagnosis.

If your AC is currently down, try these quick troubleshooting steps before calling:
- Check the thermostat settings and batteries.
- Check the breaker/fuse for the AC unit.
- Replace a very dirty filter.
- Look around the outdoor unit for obvious ice, debris, or tripped switches.

If you tell me your ZIP code and whether this is an emergency or a routine repair, I can pull up the top‑rated HVAC companies near you and suggest 2–3 to call first.
